name: B10-0125/2024 (PPE) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to rewrite the rules on medical devices and lab tests within its first hundred days. It says the current rules, meant to make devices safer, have caused delays, shortages and high costs, especially for small companies. It wants faster approvals, lower fees, more certifying bodies, easier paths for new technology and rare-disease devices, and emergency flexibility. This is a request, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose a revision of the rules.
- **Who it affects:** Patients, manufacturers (especially small firms), certifying bodies and hospitals across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose new laws; any new rules would include a transition period.
